messages:
ana: heads-up — customer reported doubled token usage after a flaky mobile reconnect; looks like partial stream + toolcall got billed twice.
ben: can you paste a trace?
ana: trace_177999: the client lost network, reconnected with resume token; proxy opened a fresh stream and also had an orphaned provisional from the old socket. both ended up confirmed.
claire: ah the classic provisional vs confirmed mismatch. toolcalls confirm on tool-response; streaming confirms on EOF. when reconnects interleave, we can end up confirming both paths.
diego: we added provisional leasing to avoid duplicate confirmed tokens but it doesn't handle interleaved toolcalls mid-stream.
ana: sample headers from trace: 
```
POST /v1/assist/stream
Host: api
X-Resume-Token: r-xy9
X-Client: mobile-2.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
```
ben: immediate fixes: 1) router: prefer resume-token merge if timestamp delta < 30s and prefixes overlap; 2) console: surface "ambiguous confirmations" and provide Reconcile action; 3) short-term billing credit for affected invoices.
claire: router-dedupe seems okay if we add a conservative overlap threshold to avoid false merges. also emit a telemetry counter for merge_attempts and merge_false_positives.
diego: console reconcile should create an immutable ReconcileRecord that references both ledger entries and the operator; billing can then apply a corrective credit. keep fields flat (comma list for ledger ids).
ana: agree. ops-bot, open a ticket for billing.
ops-bot: ticket created: BILL-3257 linking trace_177999.
ben: can we also add a flag in the streaming meter when proxy-trickle is detected so SREs can filter these sessions?
claire: yes we'll tag meter lines with proxy_trickle=true if Transfer-Encoding chunked + Proxy-Trickle header present.
diego: action items: diego -> router dedupe POC; claire -> add telemetry + console reconcile UI mock; ben -> coordinate credit approval with billing; ana -> gather more traces.
ben: timeline?
diego: POC in 5d, canary after that.
claire: console flag in 48h for ops to mark under-review.
ana: ok keep thread updated, paste any more trace ids here.
